items.title: Derrick Gardner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 9, 2013
items.q: Derrick was interviewed in Clinton, NY, on May 9, 2013, by Monk Rowe, director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Trumpeter and composer Derrick Gardner has displayed his talents in the Count Basie Orchestra, the Harry Connick Jr. Big Band, and the Smithsonian Jazz Masterworks Orchestra. He leads and records with his own sextet, the Jazz Prophets, and is currently a professor of jazz performance at the University of Manitoba.
Derrick was interviewed in Clinton, NY, on May 9, 2013, by Monk Rowe, director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
We are in the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m very pleased to have Derrick Gardner with me today, trumpeter, educator, composer. Does that do it?
